world.title: Iranian official says US attacked fishing boats off Qeshm Island, state media reports
world.summary: Iranian state media reported that a Hormozgan province official claimed the US attacked two fishing boats near Qeshm Island. The incident was reported on October 31, but there was no immediate confirmation from US authorities. The White House has not commented on the allegation, and further details regarding the incident remain unclear at this time.

world.title: Couple Rescued From Irish Beach After Rising Tide Leaves Them Stranded
world.summary: A newly engaged couple was rescued from Keel Beach in Ireland after a rising tide left them stranded. The Irish Coast Guard dispatched a cliff rescue team, which descended nearly 500 feet to reach the couple. They had been celebrating their engagement with a walk when they became trapped and were unable to return safely.

world.title: A Los Angeles man lost his office job in 2020 and began selling plants from a 600-sq-ft apartment; six years later, his family business has sold over 100,000 plants in 2026 and now brings in millions
world.summary: Brandon Hurst lost his administrative job in 2020 and began selling plants from his 600-sq-ft apartment. Over six years, his family business has sold over 100,000 plants, generating millions in revenue by 2026. Initially unplanned, Hurst's venture into plant selling has transformed his financial situation and established a successful business in the horticultural market.

business.title: Honda Rebel 300 Deliveries Starting in Nov 2026 in India
business.summary: Honda has announced that deliveries of the Rebel 300 motorcycle will begin in India in November 2026. The bike, launched in August 2026, is available in two variants: Standard priced at Rs 2.22 lakh and E-Clutch at Rs 2.62 lakh. The first batch has arrived at dealerships, and deliveries are set to start in the first week of November.

business.title: MG Price Hike Nov 2026 - Windsor By Rs 15k, Majestor By Rs 1 Lakh
business.summary: JSW MG Motor India has increased the prices of its Windsor EV by Rs 15,000 and its Majestor ICE vehicle by Rs 1 lakh. The company offers a diverse range of vehicles, with the Windsor being its best-seller and the Majestor as its flagship internal combustion engine model. The upcoming Hector Tomahawk PHEV is highly anticipated.

business.title: Is the AI boom cracking? Wall Street's tech sell-off raises questions over what comes next
business.summary: A significant sell-off in technology stocks has led Wall Street investors to reevaluate the sustainability of the artificial intelligence boom. Concerns over slowing core business growth and increasing AI-related expenditures have intensified scrutiny regarding whether the returns from AI investments will meet expectations. This situation marks a critical moment for the technology sector amid shifting market dynamics.

technology.title: Innovative Crystallization Process Paves Way for Ultra-Efficient Camera Sensors
technology.summary: Researchers have developed an innovative crystallization process that enhances the efficiency of camera sensors. These lab-created crystals, composed of atoms in precise patterns, can absorb light, transfer charge, and convert energy. This advancement has implications for various technologies, including LEDs and solar cells, potentially leading to significant improvements in the performance and capabilities of everyday camera systems.

technology.title: Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ Review: Closest I’ve Come To Replacing My Laptop With A Tablet
technology.summary: The Samsung Galaxy Tab S12+ is a premium 12.6-inch tablet aimed at replacing laptops. It features an AMOLED screen and supports a magnetic keyboard, enhancing productivity through the DeX mode. This tablet is positioned as a viable alternative for tasks like writing and research, providing a lightweight option without sacrificing functionality, making it a strong competitor in the tablet market.

technology.title: iPhone Duo's inner screen cracking issue: Apple tells stores what to do
technology.summary: Apple has addressed reports of inner display cracks on its first foldable iPhone, the iPhone Duo, by providing updated instructions to retail stores and service teams. The company states that only a small number of units are impacted. Technicians are advised to inspect affected devices and proceed with repairs or replacements as necessary to resolve the issue.

sports.title: Rest finally in sight for (some of) India's T20I globetrotters
sports.summary: India's T20I team has experienced a hectic schedule recently. Following their final match against New Zealand in Hamilton, most players will finally receive a break. This respite comes after a series of intense games, allowing the team to recuperate before future competitions. The match marks a significant point in their busy calendar, providing much-needed rest for the players.

sports.title: 'UAE se haare': Pakistan PM gets fact-checked by ex-India cricketer after 'victory over India' post
sports.summary: Pakistan Prime Minister Shehbaz Sharif congratulated the national cricket team for their victory over India in the 2026 Hong Kong Sixes tournament. In response, former India cricketer Aakash Chopra made a sarcastic remark, fact-checking Sharif's claim. The exchange highlights ongoing sports rivalries and the use of social media for commentary on international cricket events between the two nations.

sports.title: India seek bowling solutions in bid for 4-1 finish
sports.summary: India has secured the T20 series against New Zealand but faces concerns regarding their bowling performance since the T20 World Cup. With only one day between matches, the final T20I will take place at Seddon Park. The team is also preparing for upcoming one-day internationals, emphasizing the need to address bowling issues before the transition.

health.title: Scientists have deployed an AI-designed virus
health.summary: A California startup, Radical Numerics, has developed an AI-designed virus intended to combat bacterial infections. This innovative approach aims to provide an alternative to traditional antibiotics, potentially reducing the risk of antibiotic resistance. If proven effective, this method could significantly enhance treatment options for bacterial diseases, offering a new avenue for medical intervention in the ongoing battle against infections.

health.title: Barbados Eliminates Mother-to-Child HIV Transmission; WHO Confirms Health Milestone
health.summary: Barbados has achieved a significant public health milestone by eliminating mother-to-child transmission of HIV, as confirmed by the World Health Organization (WHO). This recognition places Barbados among 26 countries and territories globally that have either eliminated or are on track to eliminate such transmissions of HIV, syphilis, or hepatitis B, following extensive efforts to protect infants from infection.

health.title: Can Four Minutes of Exercise Prevent Diabetes? New Study Says Yes
health.summary: A 2026 study explored the impact of brief exercise bursts, known as "exercise snacks," on managing blood sugar in individuals with Type 2 diabetes. The findings suggest that just four minutes of movement may help prevent diabetes, addressing concerns over rising healthcare costs. This approach could offer a low-cost method for individuals to manage their health effectively.

science.title: Did comets really start life on Earth? New study challenges long-held theory
science.summary: A new study questions the established theory that comets delivered essential chemical ingredients for life on Earth. Researchers suggest alternative explanations for the origins of life, indicating that comet impacts may not have played a significant role in seeding life. This challenges previous assumptions and opens up new avenues for understanding the emergence of life on our planet.

science.title: Astronomers discover possible new dwarf planet beyond Pluto, measuring up to 1,500 km across
science.summary: Astronomers have identified a potential new dwarf planet, named 2026 ED138, located in the outer Solar System. Measuring up to 1,500 kilometers across, this object could become the sixth officially recognized dwarf planet. The discovery was made using observations from the Vera C. Rubin Observatory in Chile, revealing an object that had remained undetected for nearly a decade.

science.title: NASA Astronaut Celebrates Halloween In Space Wearing Batman Costume
science.summary: NASA astronaut Peggy Whitson celebrated Halloween in space by dressing as Batman. She shared a festive post showcasing her costume, emphasizing the popularity of superhero attire among astronauts. Whitson's choice of Batman reflected a lighthearted approach to the holiday, combining a familiar character with the unique experience of celebrating Halloween in a microgravity environment.

entertainment.title: 4 Ups & 4 Downs From WWE SmackDown (30 Oct - Results & Review)
entertainment.summary: Finn Bálor's 'Demon' character made a comeback during WWE SmackDown, while Sami Zayn successfully defended the WWE Title. Tiffany Stratton attempted another unsuccessful Money In The Bank cash-in. The episode featured a Halloween theme, celebrating the show's spooky elements. Overall, the event highlighted key moments and character developments, showcasing the ongoing storylines within the WWE universe.

entertainment.title: Ramayana advance booking ROARS: 1.70 lakh tickets sold with 5 days to go; Ranbir Kapoor, Yash eye HISTORIC opening
entertainment.summary: Advance bookings for the film "Ramayana," featuring Ranbir Kapoor and Yash, have reached 1.70 lakh tickets sold with five days remaining until its release. Directed by Nitesh Tiwari, the film is generating significant interest, indicating a potential historic opening. The momentum in ticket sales reflects strong anticipation among audiences for this epic production.

entertainment.title: T-Series acquires 50-Year exclusive global music rights for Shah Rukh Khan starrer King through Zee Music
entertainment.summary: T-Series has acquired the exclusive global music rights for the upcoming film King, starring Shah Rukh Khan, for a duration of 50 years. This agreement was facilitated by Red Chillies Entertainment and announced through Zee Music. The acquisition marks a significant move in Bollywood's music landscape, ensuring T-Series holds the commercial rights for an extended period.
